_readme: Every URL here is a place where this company appears in SOMEONE ELSE's record.
An assistant reads a company as one entity when it finds the same company
at more than one address, so these addresses are what turn a self-published
1. The legal name on every platform must be character-identical to
2. The address must be character-identical to brand.address.
3. Every platform profile must list https://shenhezhongke.com as its website.
The confirmation has to run both ways.
4. No price anywhere. Minimum order and lead time are allowed; unit price is not.
5. Real photographs only. A rendered factory is a rejected profile.
WHEN A PLATFORM IS DONE, add its URL to the sameAs list in
The gate checks that every URL in that list resolves, so a typo fails the build.
The full register, with the exact values to copy and the order of work,
is in docs/站外身份执行清单.md.

company.legalName: Guangdong Shenhe Zhongke Biotechnology Co., Ltd.
company.legalNameLocal: 广东深河中科生物科技有限公司

address.streetAddress: No.141-1 Longteng Road, Gaopugang, Yuancheng District

intellectualProperty._note: The registrations this company holds in its own name, with the number and the register each one is checked in. The same list is read by /intellectual-property.html and by content/v2/ip-assets.ts; the build gate checks the three agree.

patent.title: Space spray deodorizing device
patent.holder: Guangdong Shenhe Zhongke Biotechnology Co., Ltd. and Shenzhen Yongsheng Environmental Engineering Co., Ltd.
patent.scope: A device patent on a mobile deodorizing unit with an adjustable spray range. Not a patent on a pet care formula.
patent.verify: National patent search system, application CN202422485591.8

standard.title: Enterprise standard for the dental-care product
standard.holder: Guangdong Shenhe Zhongke Biotechnology Co., Ltd. — the drafting company
standard.scope: A standard we authored, not a certificate another body issued to us.
standard.verify: National enterprise standard information platform, Q/SHZK 12-2026

trademarks.holder: Guangdong Shenhe Zhongke Biotechnology Co., Ltd.
trademarks.note: This registration is printed with its number because it can be checked in the register today, and it is the same number published on /for-ai.html. We file other marks under the same company name as well, and those are checked by applicant name, because a trademark status changes and a number printed here can be wrong by the time a buyer reads it.
trademarks.verify: Trademark comprehensive query at sbj.cnipa.gov.cn, by registration number or applicant name

offSite._note: The platforms where the company is already listed, and the ones that are not. Every live entry has to be in the sameAs list in lib/shenhe.config.ts as well - a record that nothing points at is a record the site does not claim.

alibaba1688Factory.note: The company information page on 1688. It carries the legal name and the address (源城区高埔岗, 河源) in its own body, which is what the sameAs claim rests on.

jdFlagshipStore.note: The official flagship store on JD. The page title is the Chinese brand name.
